````text
# #3553: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S16, Jlockeed and the war heroes
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds Jlockeed's war: the Shredder, the Forever War and its Conscripts, and the war heroes who print Warhero Tokens.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP5, SP6, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## Cards

| # | Card |
| --- | --- |
| #21 | Jlockeed Shredder-12 |
| #26 | Jlockeed’s Forever War |
| #26.1 | Conscript |
| #29 | Grinder Veteran |
| #30 | Yeah I’m a War Hero |
| #141 | Stinky 1x Engineer |

## What it builds on

- The foundation (#3535): every card's catalog entry, both faces and a stub script.
- E5 (#3548): the Warhero Token.

## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- #26 Jlockeed's Forever War: a rest-of-game effect on its caster, like Stinkyscape's rest-of-game watchers.
- #29 Grinder Veteran: "Discard a Felinor" discards a Felinor-tagged card from your hand as the Activate's cost.
- #30 Yeah I'm a War Hero: only the first card you draw each turn, by any draw, is replaced.
- #141 Stinky 1x Engineer: the voice line is "Prod is down. Report the intern." (S26 renders it).

## The designer's text, verbatim

```text
**(4) Jlockeed Shredder-12 , Unit, Rare, Jlockeed, Stinkyscape+, #21**
12/16
**Tribute 1**
**Pierce**
**End of turn:** Deal 2 damage to all enemies, twice
~~~
24/32
**Tribute 1**
**Pierce**
**End of turn:** Deal 5 damage to all enemies, twice

**(1) Jlockeed’s Forever War, Spell, Jlockeed, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #26**
For the rest of the game, at the **start of your turn** summon a Conscript.
~~~
For the rest of the game, at the **start of your turn** summon a **Radiant** conscript.

**(1) Conscript, Unit, Human, Token, Common, Stinkyscape+, #26.1**
1/1
**Ranged**
~~~
2/2
**Ranged, Rush, Pierce**

**(2) Grinder Veteran, Unit, Common, Stinkyscape+, #29**
5/5
**Deft**
**Activate:** Discard a Felinor to add 2 **Warhero Tokens** to your hand.
~~~
10/10
**Deft**
**Activate:** Discard a Felinor to add 2 Radiant **Warhero Tokens** to your hand.

**(1) Yeah I’m a War Hero, Field Spell, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #30**
The first card you draw each turn is replaced with a **Warhero Token**.
~~~
The first card you draw each turn is replaced with a Radiant **Warhero Token**.

**(1) Stinky 1x Engineer, Unit, Human, Common, Stinkyscape+, #141**
2/3
**Cry**: Nerf 3 other random permanents.
{For AI: Voiceline is “Prod is down. Report the intern.”}
~~~
4/6
**Cry**: Destroy 3 other random permanents.
```

## Done when

- [ ] Every card above plays its base and Radiant faces by its text and the readings, in its own script file (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/cNNN_slug.rs`, the stub the foundation made), with tests for both faces in the same file (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (rule 10).
- [ ] Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9). A script reads state only through the prelude's helpers. A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (CLAUDE.md, Architecture).
- [ ] Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3). The cards' §8 rows say what was built.
- [ ] Every prompt these cards open is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for these cards, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check` and `names --check` pass.
- [ ] Only these cards' catalog entries and §8 rows are edited (other parts edit theirs side by side), and the set stays `Held`: players see nothing until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3548

Part of #3534.
````
